summary: Iteration 15 focused on GoogleAuthErrorHelp banner + backend /api/auth/google negative regression. Backend: 4/4 executed tests pass (1 skipped — PIN set endpoint not discoverable). Frontend: Login and Register pages render cleanly with NO banner initially (correct); component source has all required data-testids and correct href. IMPORTANT DESIGN GAP DISCOVERED: @react-oauth/google's GoogleLogin onError callback does NOT fire when GSI logs 'The given origin is not allowed for the given client ID' — GSI silently no-ops the click. So in practice on the preview URL the banner will never appear because gsiFailed is never set to true. The dead-code path needs a different trigger.

ui_bugs.issue: GSI 'origin not allowed' does NOT invoke onError of @react-oauth/google GoogleLogin — GSI silently logs to console and no-ops the click. Confirmed by clicking the rendered GSI iframe button on the preview URL: banner never appears, only console shows [GSI_LOGGER] error. Consequence: the entire GoogleAuthErrorHelp banner is effectively unreachable for the exact scenario it was designed for.

action_items: Change the banner trigger mechanism — onError from @react-oauth/google won't fire on GSI origin block. Options: (a) monkey-patch window.console.error inside a useEffect to sniff for '[GSI_LOGGER]' + 'origin is not allowed' and setGsiFailed(true); (b) render banner unconditionally (or via a small info icon) since we already know the preview origin isn't whitelisted; (c) use google.accounts.id.prompt() notification callbacks (getNotDisplayedReason / getSkippedReason). Recommended: option (a) — lightweight console sniffer with cleanup on unmount.
OPTIONAL: expose window.__setGsiFailed for future testing agents to simulate the failure without touching Google Cloud Console.

Login.jsx onError sets gsiFailed AND shows a toast — both good — but the onError never fires for the target failure mode. Trigger is the bug, not the UI.

Banner trigger via @react-oauth/google onError is currently broken for the target failure mode. If main agent switches to a console-sniff trigger, verify banner appears within ~3s of GSI init on the preview URL. All data-testids on the banner: google-auth-error-help, google-auth-error-origin, google-auth-error-copy-btn, google-auth-error-console-link.
rca of the issue: GSI (Google Identity Services) library logs '[GSI_LOGGER]: The given origin is not allowed for the given client ID' to the console when the current window.location.origin is not in the OAuth Client's Authorized JavaScript origins list. However, @react-oauth/google's <GoogleLogin> wrapper only invokes its onError prop for a narrow set of failures (button render failure, script load failure). A silent origin rejection at click-time does NOT bubble up as an error the wrapper can catch, so setGsiFailed(true) is never called and the banner never appears. Reproduction: open /login on https://finance-hardening.preview.emergentagent.com, click the 'Sign in with Google' button — nothing visible happens, console shows the [GSI_LOGGER] line, banner absent. Mitigation: main agent should replace the onError-only trigger with a console.error sniffer or render the banner as an always-visible info tooltip when GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is set but origin isn't a known-good production one.
